english.heading: Soil Health & Composting
body: Soil is more than the ground under your feet.
It is a living place that feeds crops, holds water, and carries your harvest.
In this module, learn to read soil, make safe compost, protect bare ground, and use cover crops and worm farms.

body.text: Umhlaba ungaphezu komhlaba ophantsi kweenyawo zakho.
Yindawo ephilayo. Iyazondla izityalo, igcine amanzi, ithwale nesivuno sakho.
Kule modyuli, funda ukuqonda umhlaba, wenze umgquba okhuselekileyo, ukhusele umhlaba ongenanto, kwaye usebenzise izityalo zokugquma (cover crops) neefama zeentshulube.

english.heading: Why This Matters
body: Soil condition affects roots, water and the harvest.
Repeated bare ground, compaction and loss of organic matter can damage it. Colour alone does not tell the whole story.
Observe your soil, then choose ways to protect and improve it.

body.text: Imeko yomhlaba ichaphazela iingcambu, amanzi nesivuno.
Umhlaba ongenanto ophindaphindiweyo, ukucinezeleka nokulahleka kwe-organic matter kunokuwonakalisa. Umbala wodwa awusichazi sonke isimo.
Jonga umhlaba wakho, uze ukhethe iindlela zokuwukhusela nokuwuphucula.

english.heading: Learning Outcomes
body: Look for several clues about soil condition.
Use a jar to explore soil texture, while recognising its limits.
Care for a compost heap, protect bare ground, and distinguish worm castings from liquid drainage.

body.text: Khangela imikhondo emininzi yemeko yomhlaba.
Sebenzisa ingqayi ukuphonononga ubume bomhlaba (texture), uyazi imida yayo.
Nakekela inqwaba yomgquba, ukhusele umhlaba ongenanto, kwaye wahlule inkunkuma yeentshulube (worm castings) kulwelo oluthontelayo.

english.heading: Soil Is Alive
body: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
Some fungi help roots take up nutrients. Worm channels can help water and air enter soil.
Look at roots, soil structure and water movement as well as visible soil life.

body.text: Umhlaba uqulethe iintlobo ezininzi zezinto eziphilayo. Iibhaktheriya namakhowa (i-fungi) ancedisa ekubolisweni kwe-organic matter kwaye ajikelezise izondlo.
Amanye amakhowa ancedisa iingcambu ukuba zifumane izondlo. Iindledlana zeentshulube zinokunceda amanzi nomoya ukuba angene emhlabeni.
Jonga iingcambu, isakhiwo somhlaba nokuhamba kwamanzi, kunye nobomi bomhlaba obubonakalayo.

english.heading: Watch: Read Your Soil
body: Look closely at these two soil examples.
First, look at soil structure. In the field, feel how a moist piece breaks apart.
Look at the roots and the spaces around them.
Look at the surface cover. Loose mulch covers one example.
Use several clues together. Colour alone cannot tell you soil health. Check moisture, plant growth and how water enters the ground.

body.text: Jonga ngocoselelo le mizekelo mibini yomhlaba.
Okokuqala, jonga isakhiwo somhlaba. Entsimini, bamba isiqwenga esifumileyo uzive ngesandla indlela esiqhekeka ngayo.
Jonga iingcambu nezithuba ezizijikelezileyo.
Jonga ukugquma kumphezulu. Ingca yokugquma ekhululekileyo igquma omnye umzekelo.
Sebenzisa imikhondo emininzi kunye. Umbala wodwa awukwazi ukukuxelela ngempilo yomhlaba. Hlola ukufuma, ukukhula kwezityalo nendlela amanzi angena ngayo emhlabeni.

english.heading: Explore Soil Texture with a Jar
body: Put soil and water in a clear jar, with a little suitable dispersing detergent. Close and shake it, then leave it undisturbed.
Sand settles first. Silt settles next, while clay can remain suspended much longer.
This is a rough learning exercise. Clumps and unsettled clay can mislead you; use a soil laboratory when accurate texture is needed.

body.text: Faka umhlaba namanzi kwingqayi ecacileyo, kunye nedetergent encinci efanelekileyo yokwahlula amasuntswana omhlaba (dispersing detergent). Yivale uyihlokohlise, uze uyiyeke ingashukunyiswa.
Isanti iqala ukuhlala. I-silt (umhlaba ocolekileyo kunesanti) ilandela, ngelixa udongwe lunokuhlala lumi emanzini ixesha elide kakhulu.
Eli lilingelo elilula lokufunda. Izigaqa nodongwe olungekahlali zinokukulahlekisa; sebenzisa ilebhu yomhlaba xa kufuneka ubume bomhlaba (texture) buchanekile.

english.heading: Read the Jar Carefully
body: A thick sand layer beneath cloudy water does not yet tell you the final proportions. Some fine particles may still be suspended.
Compare the settled layers and feel the soil in the field.
Record what you see and what remains uncertain. Do not prescribe watering or soil treatments from one jar alone.

body.text: Umaleko oqinileyo wesanti ngaphantsi kwamanzi anamafu awukuxeleli okwangoku umlinganiselo wokugqibela. Amanye amasuntswana acolekileyo asenokuba asamile emanzini.
Thelekisa imigangatho ehleliyo uze uvavanye umhlaba ngesandla entsimini.
Bhala oko ukubonayo nako konke okuseyinto engaqinisekanga. Musa ukumisela ukunisela okanye unyango lomhlaba ngokusekelwe kwingqayi enye kuphela.

english.heading: Investigate Before You Treat
body: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can limit roots and soil life.
Pale colour or few worms do not prove that chemicals killed the soil. Worm activity also changes with moisture and season.
Look for patterns across the field. Check management history, drainage and plant growth before choosing a remedy.

body.text: Ukuxinana komhlaba, ukungaphumi kakuhle kwamanzi nokulahleka kwe-organic matter kunokunciphisa iingcambu nobomi bomhlaba.
Umbala ophaphathekileyo okanye iintshulube ezimbalwa akungqini ukuba imichiza ibulele umhlaba. Umsebenzi weentshulube uyatshintsha nokufuma kunye nexesha lonyaka.
Jonga iipatheni kwintsimi yonke. Hlola imbali yolawulo, ukuphuma kwamanzi nokukhula kwezityalo ngaphambi kokukhetha unyango.

english.heading: Compost Feeds the Soil
body: Compost is organic matter broken down under managed conditions.
Finished compost can improve soil structure and contribute nutrients.
Time to readiness varies with materials, moisture, air and temperature. A province name or a fixed number of weeks is not a readiness test.

body.text: Umgquba yi-organic matter ebolisiweyo phantsi kweemeko ezilawulwayo.
Umgquba ogqityiweyo unokuphucula isakhiwo somhlaba kwaye unegalelo kwizondlo.
Ixesha lokulunga liyahluka ngokweempahla, ukufuma, umoya nobushushu. Igama lephondo okanye inani elimiselweyo leeveki asiso isivivinyo sokulunga.

english.heading: Watch: Build the Compost Heap
body: Build the heap with dry browns and fresh greens.
Keep the layers moist, not wet, so air and decomposers can work.

body.text: Yakha inqwaba ngezinto ezomileyo ezinsundu (browns) nezinto ezintsha eziluhlaza (greens).
Zigcine imigangatho ifumile, kungemanzi, ukuze umoya nezinto ezibolisayo (decomposers) zisebenze.

english.heading: Balance Browns and Greens
body: Mix dry browns with fresh greens. Avoid thick, wet layers that keep air out.
If the heap becomes slimy or smells strongly of ammonia, add dry browns and turn it.
Check moisture and air as the heap changes; one recipe does not suit every mix of materials.

body.text: Xuba i-browns ezomileyo ne-greens ezintsha. Phepha imigangatho eshinyeneyo, emanzi evala umoya.
Ukuba inqwaba iba bushelelezi okanye inuka kakhulu i-ammonia, yongeza i-browns ezomileyo uyiguqule.
Hlola ukufuma nomoya njengoko inqwaba itshintsha; iresiphi enye ayifaneli zonke ngxubevange zeempahla.

english.heading: Heat Alone Is Not a Safety Check
body: A hot centre does not prove that every part of a heap has been treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.
Keep meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste and contaminated materials out of this simple household system.
Do not assume home composting destroys every weed seed or disease organism. Use a recognised process where sanitation is required.

body.text: Ukuba umbindi wenqwaba ushushu akuqinisekisi ukuba yonke inxalenye yenqwaba iphathiwe. Ixesha, ubushushu nolawulo zonke ziyabalulekile.
Musa ukufaka inyama, ubisi neemveliso zobisi, izityalo ezigulayo, inkunkuma yeenja neekati nezinto ezingcolisiweyo kule nkqubo ilula yasekhaya.
Musa ukucinga ukuba ukwenza umgquba ekhaya kutshabalalisa yonke imbewu yokhula okanye zonke izinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo. Sebenzisa inkqubo eqatshelwayo apho kufuneka ucoceko.

english.heading: Keep Seed Pods and Contaminants Out
body: Keep wattle seed pods out of the compost heap. An ordinary heap may not make every seed non-viable.
Use only clean, untreated materials. Bark breaks down slowly; its name alone is not proof that it is free of contamination.
Check the heap and turn when it needs more air or mixing. Keep it moist rather than waterlogged.

heading.text: Gcina amaqokobhe embewu nezinto ezingcolisayo ngaphandle

body.text: Musa ukufaka amaqokobhe embewu (seed pods) ye-wattle enqwabeni yomgquba. Inqwaba eqhelekileyo isenokungayenzi yonke imbewu ingakwazi ukukhula.
Sebenzisa kuphela izinto ezicocekileyo, ezingaphathwanga. Ixolo lomthi libola ngokucotha; igama elithi 'ixolo' lodwa aliqinisekisi ukuba alingcolisekanga.
Hlola inqwaba uyiguqule xa ifuna umoya okanye ukuxutywa okungakumbi. Yigcine ifumile kunokuba izele ngamanzi.

english.heading: Watch: Bare Soil and Mulch
body: Compare bare soil with mulched soil.
When rain hits mulch instead of bare soil, much of the raindrop energy is dissipated. This diagram shows that surface-impact idea only; it does not predict how water will move at a particular site.

body.text: Thelekisa umhlaba ongenanto nomhlaba ogqunyiweyo.

Xa imvula ibetha ingca yokugquma endaweni yomhlaba ongenanto, uninzi lwamandla amathontsi emvula luyachithakala. Lo mzobo ubonisa kuphela ingcamango yempembelelo emphezulu; awuxeleli kwangaphambili indlela amanzi aya kuhamba ngayo kwindawo ethile.

english.heading: Mulch Protects the Ground
body: Cover bare soil with suitable clean mulch, such as straw, dry grass or wood chips.
Mulch can reduce evaporation, soften the impact of rain and suppress weeds.
Keep it clear of trunks and stems. Check moisture underneath and adjust the layer; more mulch is not always better.

body.text: Gquma umhlaba ongenanto ngengca yokugquma (mulch) efanelekileyo necocekileyo, njenge-straw, ingca eyomileyo okanye iziqwengana zomthi.
Ingca yokugquma inokunciphisa ukuphuma kwamanzi ngomphunga, ithambise ukubetha kwemvula kwaye ithintele ukhula.
Yigcine kude neziqu zemithi nezezityalo. Hlola ukufuma ngaphantsi uze ulungise umaleko; ingca yokugquma eninzi ayisoloko ilunge ngakumbi.

english.heading: Cover Crops Between Seasons
body: Cover crops can protect ground between main crops. Choose for local weather, available water and the next planting.
The course examples include oats, lupins, sunn hemp and cowpea. Check local suitability before sowing.
Legumes need suitable bacteria and growing conditions to fix nitrogen. Nutrients in their residues become available as the material decomposes.

body.text: Izityalo zokugquma (cover crops) zinokukhusela umhlaba phakathi kwezityalo eziphambili. Khetha ngokwemozulu yasekuhlaleni, amanzi akhoyo nokutyala okulandelayo.
Imizekelo yekhosi ibandakanya i-oats, i-lupins, i-sunn hemp ne-cowpea. Hlola ukufaneleka kwasekuhlaleni ngaphambi kokuhlwayela.
Ii-legume (izityalo ezifana neembotyi) zifuna ibhaktheriya efanelekileyo neemeko zokukhula ukuze zibambe i-nitrogen. Izondlo ezisentsalelweni yazo ziyafumaneka njengoko impahla ibola.

english.heading: Worm Castings and Liquid Drainage
body: Worm farms can turn suitable food scraps and bedding into castings. Check the bin rather than expecting a fixed harvest date.
Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin is called leachate. It is not the same as a prepared worm-casting tea.
Leachate can contain harmful organisms or substances. Do not use it on edible plants or assume that dilution makes it safe.

body.text: Iifama zeentshulube (worm farms) zinokuguqula intsalela yokutya efanelekileyo nezinto zokulala zibe yinkunkuma yeentshulube (worm castings). Hlola ibhokisi kunokuba ulindele umhla omiselweyo wokuvuna.
Ulwelo oluthontelayo ngokwendalo kwibhokisi yeentshulube lubizwa ngokuba yi-leachate. Aluyonto enye neti yenkunkuma yeentshulube elungisiweyo.
I-leachate inokuba nezinto eziphilayo eziyingozi okanye izinto eziyingozi. Musa ukuyisebenzisa kwizityalo ezityiwayo okanye ucinge ukuba ukuyinciphisa ngamanzi kuyenza ikhuseleke.

english.heading: Protect Soil All Year
body: A Highveld field left bare after the maize harvest faces two main risks.
Winter wind can carry away dry topsoil.
The first heavy spring storm can strike bare ground and damage its surface and structure. If water runs over the field, it can carry loosened soil away.
Cover crops, mulch, and organic matter can help hold soil in place and help it stay alive.

body.text: Intsimi yaseHighveld eshiywe ingenanto emva kokuvuna umbona ijongene neengozi ezimbini eziphambili.
Umoya wobusika unokuthwala umhlaba ongaphezulu owomileyo.
Isaqhwithi sokuqala esikhulu sentwasahlobo sinokubetha umhlaba ongenanto sonakalise umphezulu nesakhiwo sawo. Ukuba amanzi aqukuqela entsimini, anokuthwala umhlaba okhululekileyo.
Izityalo zokugquma, ingca yokugquma ne-organic matter zinokunceda ukubamba umhlaba endaweni nokuwugcina uphila.

english.heading: Field Assignment
body: Inspect soil in a working area. Record colour, structure, roots, moisture and any worm channels.
Compare another spot and note recent weather and management.
Try the jar exercise. Write what it suggests, what is uncertain, and whether a laboratory test or local adviser could help.

body.text: Hlola umhlaba kwindawo osebenza kuyo. Rekhoda umbala, isakhiwo, iingcambu, ukufuma nawaphi na amakhondo eentshulube (iindledlana).
Thelekisa nenye indawo uphawule imozulu yamva nje nolawulo.
Zama ilingelo lengqayi. Bhala oko elikuphakamisayo, oko kungaqinisekanga, nokuba ingaba uvavanyo lwelebhu okanye umcebisi wasekuhlaleni anganceda.

english.heading: Field Action
body: Start one soil-building action from this module.
Cover bare ground with mulch, begin a balanced compost heap, sow a suitable cover crop, or prepare a worm farm.
If your compost smells of ammonia and feels slimy, add dry carbon such as straw and turn it.
Build soil life step by step.

body.text: Qala isenzo esinye sokwakha umhlaba esivela kule modyuli.
Gquma umhlaba ongenanto ngengca yokugquma, qala inqwaba yomgquba elinganisiweyo, hlwayela isityalo sokugquma esifanelekileyo, okanye lungiselela ifama yeentshulube.
Ukuba umgquba wakho unuka i-ammonia kwaye ubushelelezi, yongeza i-carbon eyomileyo njenge-straw uze uwuguqule.
Yakha ubomi bomhlaba inyathelo ngenyathelo.
